title: Stat wall erodes into a completion card
summary: One result figure tiles the whole frame, blinks, then erodes glyph by glyph to black; a bold two-line done headline lands, rises to the top, and a mono stat list types in beside a growing track icon.
use_when: Closing beat of a flow: a workout, task or order has just been completed
A single hero number deserves a loud entrance before the detail
Silent vertical or 4:5 feed posts for fitness, tracking or productivity apps
A reward screen recap with three to five labelled stats

look.type_style: bold neo-grotesk, sentence case with a period, tight tracking; headline 2 lines ~10 % H; stat wall numerals ~5 % H; stats small uppercase mono ~2 % H

sfx.event: stat wall appears on the cut
stat labels and values type in

structure.shot: one result figure repeated in a 3-column, 2-block wall bleeding off the left and right edges; blinks, then erodes to black
structure.camera: static frame; wall offset left so columns crop at both edges
structure.motion: wall appears on the cut fully formed; 3 fr black blink; then glyphs drop from the end of each line, one glyph per 1-2 fr, lower lines of each block go first, wall gone in ~14 fr (30 fps strip); ~2 fr empty before the headline

structure.shot: two-line done headline (2 words with a period) centred; small brand lockup appears above it; block rises toward the top
structure.camera: static frame; headline block travels from ~51 % to ~21 % of H
structure.motion: word 1 cuts on alone, word 2 cuts on 1-2 fr later (no in-animation); lockup cuts on ~4 fr after; hold ~22 fr; rise 0.30 H on springs.layout ~20 fr, no overshoot (30 fps strip)

structure.shot: headline and lockup held at top; 4 labelled stats type in bottom left in small mono; outline circle bottom right grows into a multi-lane oval track
structure.motion: label of each line types first, value follows; a new line every ~7 fr (±0.25 s); circle thickens into concentric lanes then stretches horizontally into a stadium shape, ~20 fr, springs.ui (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: finished completion card: lockup, headline, 4-line stat list, track icon; held to the end
structure.motion: none; last value finishes typing at ~4.10, then a 61 fr hold (motion.json diff 0.00)

params.brand: any brand.json: display font for the wall and headline, mono for the stats, fg on bg (dark brands read best)
params.content.hero: the single figure tiled on the wall, with its unit, <= 7 characters
params.content.headline: two-word completion statement with a period, one word per line
params.content.stats: 3-5 {label, value} pairs, label <= 10 chars uppercase, value <= 10 chars
params.content.icon: outline shape that grows in beside the stats (default: oval track)
params.aspect: 4:5 | 9:16 | 1:1 | 16:9; wall columns and rows recompute to overfill the frame
params.timing.erode: frames for the wall to erode (default 14)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Measured on sheets (0.25 s) plus local 30 fps strips used for relative frame counts. No in-animations on the type: every element cuts on, the only eased moves are the headline rise and the icon growth. The wall must overfill the frame (crop at both sides) or it reads as a table. SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): stat-wall, glyph-erode, layout-rise, icon-grow-morph.
